**Finding submitted — deviation (INDEMN, critical).**

- **What exists:** Section 13's heading promises an IP indemnity but its text (p0088) is pure ownership language. The operative indemnity is in the following paragraph (p0090): Garman's title/quiet-enjoyment warranty plus an indemnity for "Losses" from breach of that warranty, a 10-day notice condition, and procure/replace/modify remedies at (a)–(c). Section 15 disapplies the liability cap to Section 13, so the indemnity is uncapped — better than the fallback 3× super-cap. No Customer-side indemnity exists anywhere (Sections 3, 20 checked); no exclusions for our modifications/combinations/specifications.
- **Why it fails:** No refund where (a)–(c) are unavailable (fallback gap), and at preferred there is no duty to defend, no affiliate coverage, and nothing for Garman's breach of law, Garman-caused data breach, or gross negligence/wilful misconduct, nor any defence-control or cooperation mechanic.
- **Cure:** One inserted paragraph after p0093 carrying only the preferred elements; we deliberately did not import the fallback super-cap (it would weaken our current uncapped indemnity) and did not create a Sparkling indemnity — the closing sentence only confines any such obligation to our content and our breach of law.
